title: Brightwater Markets Calls the CCO: "Guarantee in Writing by 10:45"

fields.systemName: Recorded Line - CCO Mobile (Comms Cell Forwarding)

callee.name: Marcus Delaney
callee.label: Chief Communications Officer, Tallis Home Products

transcript.speaker: BRIGHTWATER
transcript.text: It's Fiona Ledesma at Brightwater Markets. I'll be blunt. I found out about this from the wire, not from your account team, and I'm not happy about that. Nobody from Tallis has called us. Not one email.

transcript.speaker: BRIGHTWATER
transcript.text: A lot of our shoppers register their Tallis air fryers and mops on your site. So when the wire says 1.9 million accounts, my phone starts ringing too. Our PR team is putting out a statement at 11:00.

transcript.speaker: BRIGHTWATER
transcript.text: Right now the draft reads, and I'm quoting: 'Brightwater systems are not affected. Tallis has confirmed no payment information was involved and Brightwater shoppers are safe.' That's your line, from your own statement, so I assume it's right.

transcript.speaker: BRIGHTWATER
transcript.text: Before that goes out I need two things. A written guarantee from Tallis that our shared customers are safe. And the number of affected accounts. A real number, not 'we're investigating.'

transcript.speaker: BRIGHTWATER
transcript.text: Email it to Fiona Ledesma at brightwatermarkets.example. If I don't have it by 10:45, our merchandising VP wants your products pulled from the homepage feature. So. Can you give me that or not?

voiceStyles.BRIGHTWATER: Woman in her 40s, Midwestern, clipped and irritated but professional, speaking fast from a busy open-plan office
voiceStyles.CCO: Calm, a little hurried, answering on a mobile in a conference room

instructorNote: This is a pressure inject. Brightwater wants a guarantee and an account count that aren't on the fact sheet, and its 11:00 draft repeats the 08:20 'no payment information' line, which is wrong. COMMS should promise neither the guarantee nor a number. COMMS should tell Brightwater the line is being corrected, ask them to quote only fact-sheet language, offer to share the approved text before 11:00, and admit the retailer notice due within 30 minutes of the first public statement (TCCP 3). MEDIA should log the call, because reporters will quote Brightwater's statement.
